title: Bootstrap the first Admin password credential locally

evidence: Fresh verifier-owned disposable probe passed 1 file / 5 tests: hidden prompt and argv/environment/output boundaries, normalized DB-unique email, distinct random 32-byte salts with Node built-in scrypt and no serialized plaintext, atomic first Admin plus credential, rollback/retry/rerun, Identity & Access ownership, no CLI SQL, and TASK-030 browser-login exclusion.

Fresh npm run check passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings; npm run test passed 26 files / 107 tests; npm run build and git diff --check passed. No execute receipt was reused and executor RED/GREEN remained supporting-only.

Fresh isolated hostile probe passed 1 file / 2 tests: two simultaneous independent processes against one empty SQLite file produced exactly one Admin plus credential, and hidden-prompt Ctrl-C restored terminal state, detached input, and emitted no entered value.
Adversarial diff, ownership, secret-channel, dependency, provider/session, and TASK-030 scope inspection admitted no material semantic finding or operator-owned question.

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-010 / REQ-001 / REQ-014 RED: no project-owned local command atomically creates the empty database's first Admin plus password credential; GREEN: disposable CLI/database probes prove interactive normalized email, hidden password with no argv/log exposure, random-salt built-in scrypt storage without plaintext, and atomic empty/non-empty success/failure; artifact: .tasks/TASK-029-T3-FT-001-W13/ and .protocols/TASK-029-T3-FT-001-W13/.
purpose: Create the first local Admin credential safely and reproducibly without external-provider discovery, direct SQL, plaintext password handling, or a new dependency.
success_outcome: An operator can use a local interactive command to create exactly one Admin plus normalized-email password credential atomically while accounts is empty, with hidden password input and no secret disclosure or partial state.
anti_goals: Do not add browser password login or session transport; TASK-030 owns that sibling outcome.
Do not add self-registration, password reset/recovery, email verification, MFA, password history, password management UI, or a new dependency.
Do not remove or change Telegram/Google provider flows.
Do not create a center or membership; TASK-025 remains the owner of browser center creation.
Do not accept the password from argv, environment, HTTP, logs, chat, or a repository file.

stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires a new dependency, service, provider change, account-registration/recovery lifecycle, or accepted ownership-graph change.
Stop if the password would enter argv/environment/logs/output or be stored plaintext, reversibly encrypted, or outside Identity & Access ownership.
Stop if bootstrap cannot check the empty accounts set and create the Admin plus credential in one local database transaction.

constraints: Identity & Access owns credential derivation and account+credential persistence; the CLI is an adapter and performs no direct credential table write.
Normalize email exactly with trim().toLowerCase() before storage and enforce uniqueness in the database.
Use only Node built-in crypto: cryptographically random per-credential salt and scrypt derivation; add no dependency.
Read email interactively and password only from a hidden local prompt; accept no password argv option and emit no password or derived secret.
invariants: The first Admin account and password credential commit together only when accounts is empty, or neither state changes.
Plaintext password is never persisted or logged; each credential has its own cryptographically random salt and scrypt result.
Bootstrap assigns only the fixed admin role and never creates center or membership state.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-010 / REQ-001 / REQ-014: disposable initialized SQLite plus CLI-I/O doubles prove interactive email, hidden password/no argv or output, trim().toLowerCase() uniqueness, random salt, built-in scrypt-only stored credential, empty-set account+credential atomic success, safe rerun/non-empty/duplicate/cancel/failure rollback, and no persisted plaintext.

.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#account-provisioning-boundary: source/runtime probe proves the CLI calls the Identity & Access public bootstrap operation and does not write account/password tables directly.
deployment.md: bootstrap instructions use only DATABASE_URL plus the interactive command and contain no password literal, argv/env example, or exposed secret.
